name: tab01
definition: 主数据记录一 Counterexample: 与 tab02、tab03 的区分待专家确认：三表列集合不重叠，可能分属不同业务域，不能仅凭表名判定为同一实体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab01; provenance: direct source tab01

name: tab02
definition: 主数据记录二 Counterexample: 与 tab01 的区分待专家确认：列集合与 tab01 不重叠，是否为其扩展表或独立实体缺乏证据 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab02; provenance: direct source tab02

name: tab03
definition: 主数据记录三 Counterexample: 与 tab01 的区分待专家确认：两表均含 fld001，可能是共享主键或共享租户/组织列，需数据核验后才能判定是否同一实体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: School
definition: A K-12 public school record in the county/district system.

name: County
definition: The county in which a school is located.

name: District
definition: The school district a school belongs to.

name: FreeMealEligibleCount
definition: Number of students eligible for free or reduced price meals.
aliases: free or reduced price meal count

name: EnrollmentK12
definition: Total enrollment for grades K-12.

name: EnrollmentAge5to17
definition: Enrollment count for ages 5 through 17.

name: PhoneNumber
definition: Contact phone number of the school.

name: StreetAddress
definition: Full street/mailing address of the school.

name: OpenDate
definition: Date the school opened.

name: MathAvgScore
definition: Average math score for a school (SAT).
aliases: average of average math score for SAT

name: ReadingAvgScore
definition: Average reading score for a school.

name: WritingAvgScore
definition: Average writing score for a school.

name: FreeMealRate
definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free/reduced meals. Formula: FreeMealEligibleCount / EnrollmentK12. Inputs: FreeMealEligibleCount = tab01.fld022; EnrollmentK12 = tab01.fld019
aliases: eligible free or reduced price meal rate

name: EnrollmentDiffK12vs5to17
definition: Difference between K-12 enrollment and ages 5-17 enrollment. Formula: EnrollmentK12 - EnrollmentAge5to17. Inputs: EnrollmentK12 = tab01.fld019; EnrollmentAge5to17 = tab01.fld024

name: AvgMathScore
definition: Mean of school average math scores. Formula: AVG(MathAvgScore). Inputs: MathAvgScore = tab03.fld041

name: AvgReadingScore
definition: Mean of school average reading scores. Formula: AVG(ReadingAvgScore). Inputs: ReadingAvgScore = tab03.fld042

name: AvgWritingScore
definition: Mean of school average writing scores. Formula: AVG(WritingAvgScore). Inputs: WritingAvgScore = tab03.fld043

name: TopNMathScoreRank
definition: Rank of schools by average math score. Formula: RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MathAvgScore DESC). Inputs: MathAvgScore = tab03.fld041

name: TopNReadingByCounty
definition: Rank of schools by reading score within county. Formula: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY County ORDER BY ReadingAvgScore DESC). Inputs: ReadingAvgScore = tab03.fld042; County = tab01.fld004
aliases: top 5 in respective counties by reading
